Here’s why every accusation in this meme falls apart.

❌ Graphic Claim: “Republican Clean CR – bipartisan support, 7 week clean extension, that’s it.”
✅ Reality: The House CR runs until November 21, 2025. It is not clean. It delays Medicaid hospital cuts, extends rural and low-volume hospital payments, and keeps telehealth flexibilities, but it excludes ACA subsidies and Medicaid protections that millions depend on. Leaving out vital coverage is not “clean,” it is partisan.

❌ Graphic Claim: “Democrats demand $1 trillion to keep the government open for 4 weeks.”
✅ Reality: Totally fabricated. Democrats are not demanding $1 trillion. They want to protect ACA subsidies and Medicaid so families do not lose healthcare. That is maintaining services, not creating new ones.
